asking.label: in line with the market
asking.summary: The asking price sits inside the band that comparable trucks of this age and mileage are listed at.

adjustment.cap_basis: measured: one out-of-fold residual standard deviation of the price model (+/-9.4%) - the variation in asking price that year, kilometres, brand and market do not explain
adjustment.weights_basis: assumed, not fitted: the severity x impact weight table, the per-subsystem saturation decay, the family value weights and the coverage thresholds are all hand-set. This corpus carries no condition ground truth to fit them against, so they are stated rather than measured

widened: only 74% of the truck by value was photographed legibly, so the condition band widens 1.09x (an assumption, not a measurement)
the synthesis pass graded this fair and the deterministic rollup grades it good, so the condition band widens 1.08x (an assumption)
caveats: Trained on ASKING prices, not realised sale prices - the honest caveat, not a hidden one. Expect realised prices to sit below the band.

The measured interval coverage belongs to the comparable-asking band. The condition-adjusted band is that estimate moved by what the photos show, which is a deliberate departure from what sellers ask and is not covered by the same measurement.
Turkish prices converted at 48.596 TRY/USD as of 2026-09-11; at ~30% annual inflation this rate goes stale fast - refit rather than quote it later.
The Turkish comparables are brand-concentrated (78 of 84 Turkish listings are FORD), so an unfamiliar make is priced off the market average rather than off its own curve.
